'''Fudbalski klub Inđija''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|Фудбалски клуб Инђија}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Inđija]], [[Serbia]]. They compete in the [[:sr:Општинске_лиге_Србије_у_фудбалу|Serbian Municipal League]], the seventh tier of the [[Serbian football league system|national league system]]. FK Inđija officially announced its withdrawal from the [[Serbian League Vojvodina]] on 25 July 2026 after large amount of debts they were unable to pay.<ref>{{Cite web |title=UGASIO SE SRPSKI VELIKAN! Klub sa skoro 100 godina istorije odlazi u zaborav zbog milionskog duga |url=https://www.espreso.co.rs/sport/fudbal/1611804/ugasio-se-srpski-velikan-klub-sa-skoro-100-godina-istorije-odlazi-u-zaborav-zbog-milionskog-duga |access-date=2026-07-29 |website=espreso.co.rs |language=sr}}</ref>

During Yugoslavia the club mainly participated in the amateur ranks of competition.

The club's biggest success were two promotions to the [[Serbian SuperLiga]] for 2010–11 and 2019–20 seasons."}}
